chapter: New York, Dallas and Kansas City
title: Don Purcell's band in Dallas with Alberta Hunter and Pete Newton
summary: In Dallas he worked at Aven Pap's with Alberta Hunter and the dancer Pete Newton and his partner Peaches.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: For Oklahoma. How long did you stay in Oklahoma?

Oklahoma? Things were happening so fast. I don't think I was in Oklahoma no longer than -- not a year at all. Because after Oklahoma, I went to Dallas. Dallas, Texas, with a band called Don Purcell. We were playing at Aven Pap's. That's where I worked with Alberta Hunter and Pete Newton.
Oh, yeh, he was a beautiful dancer. He used to have a partner with him by the name of Peaches. The act was called Pete and Peaches. They were great, they were headliners.
Alberta Hunter, she was big there. She

Yeh, she was the star. She was great then as she is now at her age. She was beautiful. I was so glad to have worked with Alberta Hunter.
How large was the band that worked with Alberta Hunter? This was Purcell's band.
Purcell, yeh. We had about ten pieces. Then we were switched from there --
Were you the only trombone player?
